title: Transforming Cities: Trying to save one beach at a time
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Trying to save one beach at a time,” an urban initiative documented for Oceanside. It is included because it addresses coastal flood hazards. C40 describes the action this way: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

intervention.objectives: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.
intervention.measures:
The community effort to protect Oceanside’s seashores 
 As sea levels rise and the ocean swallows the sand, Oceanside residents are coming together to protect the coastline they love. Watch how local organisations are innovating and adapting to slow coastal erosion and build a more resilient seaside city.
 MORE FROM THE ‘TRANSFORMING CITIES’ SERIES 
 This content was produced for Resilient Cities Catalyst (Alumbra Foundation) by BBC StoryWorks as part of the Transforming Cities series presented by C40 Cities. Learn more about Transforming Cities: www.transformingcitiesseries.com
